tiles.name: Failed units
tiles.exec:
raw=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain) || exit 1
units=$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | awk 'NF{print $1}')
n=$(printf '%s\n' "$units" | grep -c .)
if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo "bad $n failed · $(printf '%s' "$units" | head -n 2 | tr '\n' ' ')"; else echo "ok none failed"; fi
